title: Unique and Practical
text: Unique and Practical. I love the big, bright numbers and the unique color.  The numbers look like they're floating in the dark.

product_metadata.title: EAAGD 3D Digital Alarm Clock with 3 Adjustable Brightness, 12/24Hr, Snooze, Bedroom Desk Alarm Clock LED Nightlight Digital Wall Clock (White/Green)
features: 【 Fashionable styling】 3D 8888 modeling, white LED number, and novel styling
3 brightness adjustment levels】 To avoid the light too bright at night, the alarm clock is equipped with 3 brightness adjustment levels. It can adjust automatically and can also be adjusted manually
【Alarm and snooze function】 It has wake up function and snooze function. And the snooze time can be freely adjusted
【Multi-scene usage】 Size 21.5 * 4 * 8.7cm; It can be placed on the desktop arbitrarily, or hung on the wall as a wall clock

【USB or charging head for power supply connection】 The alarm clock can only work with power connected . It can be connected with USB cable or AC adapter. Both USB cable and AC adapter are equipped with the alarm clock when ship
